roles.linear: A linear RGB master of the Carina Nebula, the maintainer's own data
roles.linear2: A copy of the linear master under a name of its own, RGB-linear.fit, so that it opens beside the first as a second image
roles.red: The red stack of the Carina set the linear master was composed from, the maintainer's own data
roles.green: The green stack of the same set, the maintainer's own data
roles.blue: The blue stack of the same set, the maintainer's own data
roles.lum: The luminance stack of the same set, the maintainer's own data
roles.flat: A master flat of the Carina Nebula set, the maintainer's own data
roles.ngc253: The NGC 253 color-camera set of the workflow pages: a folder of lights, darks, flats and bias frames, the maintainer's own data
roles.eagle: The Eagle Nebula narrowband lights and flats of the workflow pages, the maintainer's own data
roles.cfa: A raw color-filter frame of the NGC 253 set, the maintainer's own data
roles.synthetic: A synthetic mono frame made for the purpose
roles.work: An empty folder a recipe writes to - a project, a run's output - whose path names nothing personal, such as D:\Captures, since a picture may show it
roles.starnet: A storage root kept by an earlier run, whose settings name the StarNet2 program (tools/starnetPath)
roles.deepsnr: A storage root kept by an earlier run, whose settings name the DeepSNR program (tools/deepsnrPath)
roles.gaia: A storage root kept by an earlier run, with a Gaia catalog pack installed for plate solving and an Image Integration job of the NGC 253 lights
roles.spcc: A storage root kept by an earlier run, with the catalogs spectrophotometric color calibration needs
roles.tools: A storage root kept by an earlier run, whose settings name the external tools a page uses
roles.cfaname: Not a path: the name of the raw color-filter frame's view, its file name without the extension
roles.eaglelight: Not a path: the file name of a registered Ha light of the Eagle set, as the run wrote it
roles.extensions: A storage root kept by an earlier run, with the extensions the extension pages show installed
roles.jupiter: An 8-bit SER video of Jupiter from the project's sample data
